scope: Seen development input sensitivity, not duplicate detection accuracy or independent owner inference
fit_policy: Fit on the original 2180 native docs only; freeze vocabulary and IDF across projections and interventions

projections.docs: Function native_text; firmware normative_responsibility, document_report and planned_capability claims only
projections.docs_source: Same documentation plus source_observation claims in original order; no unknown, evidence paths, kind labels or verdicts

queries.text: replace permission bits while preserving file type
collect the complete command before invoking the handler
partial input copy failure and handler side effects
decode device tree node properties and translate addresses
lookup interrupt controller specification for a device
responsibility for IRQ mapping MMIO mapping and DMA allocation

budget: Top1 positive-score candidate per query; all 3 scores retained; same query count, candidate identities and rank budget, NOT equal context length or extraction cost
ranking: Cosine rounded to 12 decimals descending; candidate id ascending for ties; zero scores excluded; no correctness labels
controls: Existing candidates keep exact scores when their text is unchanged
Native empty command retained as zero evidence
limits: Source observations are researcher-authored summaries, not automatically inferred
Firmware docs are edited design claims, function docs are native; compare within packet, not absolute performance across packets
Intervention on absent source claim has no effect in docs arm
Norm reversal is alternative norm, not known wrong label
No semantic accuracy, refactoring benefit, or new-method claim
completion: Execute all 16 conditions, archive inputs/scores/OOV, verify repeats and manual formula, synthesize adverse results without tuning
